integrity: The proof is exact and analytic. It uses a published five-point shoelace bound as its only nontrivial external lemma; the induction identity and sharpness construction are elementary determinant calculations.
scientific_limitations: The result controls signed shoelace area, not unsigned lobe area or geometric union area.
It supplies the exact unconditional coefficient for arbitrary ordered lists but does not itself improve the motivating universal-cover numerical bounds.
Targeted novelty searches cannot exclude an older equivalent result under different polygonal-line terminology.
title: Sharp signed-area amplification for ordered points in a convex set
